paper.arxiv.2110.14990

Prepared 15 Nov 2026 · Evidence snapshot 12 Nov 2026 · Report research-2026-11-12.1 · Evidence research-2026-11-11.candidate.1

Evidence & scope

Substantive bounded primary methods/results/limitations source review is documented at 2110.14990v2. Pairwise crowd-comparison construction and sampling/age/gender restrictions are substantive data/QC research; source title/version match. No population fairness or independent family audit inferred. Original author/source-verifier/adversarial receipts bind every exact approved fact; unread pages, unreplicated experiments and source conflicts remain recorded in the pinned dossier. This admission is for one logical paper work only.

Approved findings

Approved evidence · As of 10 Nov 2026

The authors noticed incorrect gender metadata in the source and allowed a person to appear in multiple age groups; within-age-group comparisons were harder and graph disconnection prevented meaningful Bradley–Terry ranking in some subgroup evaluations.

Approved evidence · As of 10 Nov 2026

IMDB-WIKI-SbS sampled 75 photos per age 10–70 and binary gender from IMDB-WIKI, yielding 9, 150 photos, and constructed 250, 249 comparison edges in a connected random graph.

Approved evidence · As of 10 Nov 2026

On Toloka, 4, 091 workers each chose the older of two cropped faces; each pair had one unique annotator, with three regular and one control task per page. QC used top-half English-speaking workers, timing/skipping checks and 200 gold comparisons with over 20-year age gaps.

Approved evidence · As of 10 Nov 2026

Whole-dataset NDCG@100 was 0.859 for Bradley–Terry, 0.803 for PageRank and 0.490 for the random baseline; these are age-ranking results on the connected comparison graph, not personal identity or fairness outcomes.
